s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Sensor type)
a. Passive sensor
b. Active sensor
c. Optical sensor
d. SAR sensor

List-II (Characteristic)
i. Uses its own signal and reads the echo
 ii. Uses reflected light and is affected by cloud cover
 iii. Detects natural sunlight or emitted heat
 iv. Uses microwave energy and can operate through cloud and darkness

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
x: Passive sensors detect natural sunlight or emitted heat; active sensors transmit their own signal. Optical sensors use reflected light, while SAR uses microwaves and can observe through clouds and in darkness.
